Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: In step 10, the WebSurfer agent hallucinated specific details not present in the visible page content. The agent claimed that "Britannica indicates that Jefferson Davis served as a lieutenant in the Mexican-American War, which lasted from 1846 to 1848. Therefore, his end-of-service date in that war is May 30, 1848." However, the provided text from the Britannica page (step 9) only shows the top of the biography (intro, birth/death dates, Senate terms) and does not contain any mention of the Mexican War, the date May 30, 1848, or an end-of-service date. The agent invented the date based on external knowledge rather than extracting it from the source, leading to the incorrect specific date being used as the solution.
